# Full Technical Knowledge Base: Ryan Ardian

Title: Fullstack Software Engineer & DevOps / Network Specialist
Badge: #OPENTOWORK
Canonical Site: https://ardianryan.com

## Engineering Biography & Overview
I am a Fullstack Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, and Network Infrastructure Specialist with extensive experience designing, developing, and deploying mission-critical systems across software, virtualization, and networking layers.

My engineering focus centers on high-throughput backend architectures with Laravel and Hono.js, reactive frontends using React and TypeScript, and enterprise-grade infrastructure. On the DevOps & server orchestration side, I specialize in bare-metal and cloud virtualization using Proxmox VE and VMware ESXi, Docker containerization, VPS fleet management, Linux server hardening, and Cloudflare edge services (R2, Hyperdrive, Turnstile, Tunnels).

In addition to building scalable web applications and POS platforms, I actively serve as an Informatics Educator at SMA Negeri 1 Gedeg, mentoring the next generation in computer science, DevOps workflows, and hands-on MikroTik & virtualization lab environments.

## Comprehensive Project Architecture & Deep Dives

------------------------------------------------------------
### PROJECT: AKAS V2 - Academic Security System
ID: akas | Year: 2026 | Category: Academic Security App | Status: Private - Active Development
Technologies: Laravel 11, React SPA, Inertia.js, TailwindCSS, Cloudflare R2
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/ardianryan
URL: https://ardianryan.com/projects/akas

**Summary:**
A comprehensive school discipline & academic monitoring platform. Migrated from legacy PHP Native monolith to modern Laravel API + React SPA architecture with Google OAuth, Cloudflare R2, and Progressive Web App support.

**Technical Architecture & Case Study Blog:**
AKAS V2 is an enterprise academic safety and discipline management system designed specifically for high-capacity educational institutions.

### The Problem
Legacy monolithic systems previously suffered from high latency during morning peak hours when thousands of students tapped their physical RFID cards at the school gate simultaneously.

### Architecture & Solution
1. Decoupled the backend into high-performance Laravel 11 API endpoints with Redis queue caching.
2. Built an offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) client interface using React SPA and Inertia.js.
3. Integrated Cloudflare R2 for zero-egress cost photo asset storage, drastically reducing operational server bandwidth overhead.
4. Configured automated Google OAuth single sign-on with role-based access control for administrative staff, teachers, and security officers.

**Screenshots & UI Modules:**
- Admin Dashboard Overview: Real-time stats monitor for daily attendance and student safety alerts. 
- Security Incident Logs: Dashed table displaying gate entries, late timestamps, and check-ins. 
- Cloudflare R2 File Assets: Secured cloud storage mapping students photo profile IDs.

### PROJECT: Satenya Mama Loesye - POS & Management System
ID: satenya | Year: 2026 | Category: POS & Catering System | Status: Live
Technologies: React, Hono.js, Prisma ORM, TypeScript, Docker
Live Demo: https://satenyamamaloesye.ppti.me
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/ardianryan
URL: https://ardianryan.com/projects/satenya

**Summary:**
Point of Sales & catering management system with a bold neobrutalist UI. Features Kitchen Display System synchronization, dynamic QRIS generation, WhatsApp OTP authentication, and delivery radius validation.

**Technical Architecture & Case Study Blog:**
Satenya Mama Loesye is a custom-engineered Point of Sale (POS) and kitchen management system built for high-volume culinary catering operations.

### Core Engineering Highlights
- **Real-Time Kitchen Sync:** Orders punched at the cashier station appear on the kitchen display queue in under 80 milliseconds via lightweight WebSockets.
- **Dynamic QRIS Integration:** Automatic payment generation connected directly to payment gateway webhooks for immediate transaction settlement.
- **Neobrutalist Interface:** Designed specifically for touchscreens and tablet devices with tactile feedback and high-contrast accessibility.
- **Docker Containerization:** Fully containerized setup deployed across isolated Docker environments with automated health checks.

**Screenshots & UI Modules:**
- POS Cashier Terminal: Interactive interface optimized for tablet screen transactions. 
- Kitchen Queue Screen: Real-time synchronized display for cooking stations. 
- Dynamic QRIS Modal: Auto-generated payment codes via API with secure webhook hooks.

### PROJECT: ScholarGate SSO - Portal & CMS
ID: scholargate | Year: 2026 | Category: SSO & School CMS | Status: Private - Active
Technologies: Laravel, React, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2, OAuth2
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/ardianryan
URL: https://ardianryan.com/projects/scholargate

**Summary:**
Central school education portal and CMS designed for shared-hosting or VPS. Supports Google OAuth SSO, portable JSON data backups, and multi-database configurations.

**Technical Architecture & Case Study Blog:**
ScholarGate serves as a centralized authentication hub and modern content management platform for academic communities.

### Key Capabilities
- **Unified Single Sign-On:** Seamless redirection with Google OAuth2 enabling teachers and students to log in without managing separate credentials.
- **Hybrid Database Agnostic Architecture:** Capable of running seamlessly on SQLite for simple self-contained deployments or scaling up to PostgreSQL.
- **Secure Data Exports:** Automated database backup tools generating verified JSON snapshots for offline archiving.

**Screenshots & UI Modules:**
- Google OAuth Portal: Centralized credential verification using safe SSO redirection. 
- Database Multi-tenant Config: System admin config supporting separate SQLite / PG databases.

### PROJECT: SIEKSA V3 - School Extracurricular System
ID: sieksa | Year: 2026 | Category: Extracurricular Panel | Status: Private - Active
Technologies: React, TypeScript, Hono.js, PostgreSQL, Docker
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/ardianryan
URL: https://ardianryan.com/projects/sieksa

**Summary:**
Web-based extracurricular administrative panel managing student directories, meeting logs, performance metrics, and automated achievement verification.

**Technical Architecture & Case Study Blog:**
SIEKSA V3 is an open-source extracurricular management suite designed to eliminate paper-based logs and manual attendance rosters in schools.

### Highlights
- Built with high-speed Hono.js edge APIs and typed React UI.
- Integrated CSV analytics export for monthly activity compliance.
- Role-based approvals allowing mentors and student presidents to verify attendance logs digitally.

**Screenshots & UI Modules:**
- Student Roster Table: Extracurricular member directory with search and CSV reports. 
- Meeting Attendance Log: Digital ledger verify student attendance with automated approvals. 

## Distributed Network Topology
### Node: Cloud Services (Position: 250, 60)
- Description: Edge networks, global DNS routing, and secure object storage for project assets.
- Stack: Cloudflare R2, Cloudflare DNS, WAF

### Node: MikroTik RouterOS (Position: 250, 160)
- Description: Core routing, firewall rules, user session management, and traffic queueing policies.
- Stack: VLANs, QoS Bandwidth Mgmt, WireGuard VPN

### Node: Managed Switch (Position: 250, 260)
- Description: Local ethernet aggregation segmenting server VLANs from client networks.
- Stack: L2/L3 Switching, Trunk Ports, Network Isolation

### Node: Application Server (Position: 120, 360)
- Description: Hosting web services like AKAS v2, ScholarGate SSO, and Satenya Mama Loesye.
- Stack: Laravel 11+, React SPA, Hono.js POS, Docker

### Node: Database Node (Position: 250, 360)
- Description: Structured storage nodes for school achievements, POS transactions, and user credentials.
- Stack: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Prisma ORM

### Node: Client Stations (Position: 380, 360)
- Description: End-user devices accessing school systems and POS cashier clients.
- Stack: WiFi Captive Portal, POS Terminals, PWA Devices
